rule: For the arms dense and l1 the lower bound of the learning-rate range is extended by one log10 decade (low_new = low_old / 10); the upper bound and every other hyperparameter range are unchanged; the same rule for both arms; no other arm and no other part of the protocol changes.

amendment_1.rule: the validation-only second-stage re-selection of 18-main-d8/swm-rollout joins the re-run, unchanged: trigger (fragility >= log10 1.5 or an exploded final, and a validation bump >= 0.10 log10 above both neighbour sizes), K = 4 candidates by the record's key, M = 8 seeds of the bank 'resel', selection by the mean log10 validation rollout score then one-step then rank, the 16 finals of a changed winner; the comparison against the adopted record
amendment_1.disclosure: a partial test run of the reader at 20:05 computed test AULC of 31 complete cells; the trigger and the selection use validation only

adoption.rule: the re-run's finals (the selected configuration of every cell on the record's 16 paired final seeds; the second stage changed no winner) are the adopted record's Dense and L1 arms on the 17 counted tasks, both arms together; LeWi and every other arm unchanged (the in5 seeds and the re-selection); the record's Dense and L1 finals stay in the sealed and the prior tables

names.prior: the record the re-run was compared against: the record as run with the in5 seeds and the re-selection (called adopted before this adoption)
names.updated: the comparison with the re-run arms: the adopted record's
